description: Watch one yield note to expiry: a heads-up the day before, the outcome the moment it settles, and - if the owner asked for it - buying the asset they have just agreed to buy.

INSTRUMENT.description: Derive's own name for the option sold, exactly as it was filled: ETH-20261030-2450-P. The expiry and strike are read back out of this, so it must match the fill.

PRODUCT.description: Which note this is. A put ends in the owner buying the asset; a call ends in them selling it.

UNDERLYING.description: The asset ticker: ETH, BTC. Used for the settlement read and, if DELIVER_ASSET is on, the spot buy.

STRIKE.description: The price the owner agreed to buy at (put) or sell at (call).

SIZE.description: Contracts sold, in units of the underlying.

PREMIUM_USD.description: What the owner actually kept at open, after Derive's fee. This is the number quoted back to them at expiry, so it must be the net figure, not the gross.

COLLATERAL_USD.description: USDC locked behind a put. 0 for a covered call, which is collateralised by the asset itself.

DELIVER_ASSET.description: Only for a put that lands in the money. Derive settles in cash, so the owner is simply down money and holds no asset. With this on, the duty files a spot buy for SIZE of the underlying, which is what makes 'you now own it at the strike' true. Off by default: it spends money, so the owner has to have asked.

CHAIN_ID.description: Chain for the DELIVER_ASSET buy: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum.

HEADS_UP_HOURS.description: How long before expiry to send the heads-up. Sent once.
